evidence: BaseProjectileTemplate.deflectionPower < 0.5 sets Projectile.C=true; laser-defence scanning in anti-projectile buildings skips active projectiles when C is true, while non-skipped projectiles use deflectionPower H.

Experimental laser projectile setup sets E=true together with laserEffect/instant flags; update() repeatedly applies directDamage/60*delta*getLifeProgressRatio while E is true and suppresses the normal one-shot impact removal path.
Projectile.getLifeProgressRatio compares ageTimer J against F and returns J/F until the ramp reaches 1; the continuous laser projectile initializes J and F before repeated damage is applied.
Projectile.drawMainLayer decrements N each frame while lightingEffect M is active; when it reaches zero it resets to 4 and regenerates the segment offset array.
Projectile.drawMainLayer allocates O as a float[20] and fills it with random -10..10 offsets used to perturb each lighting-effect line segment.
Projectile.update checks as before scanning all active units for contact against the projectile position and triggers impact when a unit falls within contactCollisionRadius + unit.radius.
Projectile.update checks at before converting the projectile world position to a map cell and triggering impact when the pathing grid reports the terrain as blocked for movement type ao.f.
When collideWithUnits is true, update() expands the broad-phase search by aA + 50 and performs a final distance test against aA + target.collisionRadius.
Projectile.update removes projectiles with no live target unless aC is true; direct-ground/linked projectile creators set aC=true and write fixed target coordinates n/o/m instead of following Unit l.
In the ballistic branch, update() moves height eq toward ballisticHeight aJ until it reaches the peak, then sets aK=true and begins moving height back toward the target height near impact.
The ballistic branch uses aL*delta as the height interpolation speed when aL >= 0; custom projectile application sets it to -1 to fall back to projectile horizontal speed.
During continuousDamage target tracking, update() accumulates aO and emits a smoke/explosion helper near the target whenever it exceeds roughly 75 ticks, then resets it to a randomized small value.
setSourceAndPosition resets bn=false; update() sets bn=true on impact and then uses it to run area-damage expansion/removal countdowns instead of processing further travel collision.
Projectile.updateAreaDamage clears static list bi, asks the spatial unit index for units around the impact point into bi, iterates it for area damage, then clears it again.
